map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.向 3 个公共 STUN 分别取 srflx 映射的 IP:端口，按端口是否一致: Query srflx mappings from 3 public STUN servers and infer cone vs symmetric NAT from port consistency.
map.向多个 STUN 服务器分别发起映射请求，比较返回的公网映射端口：若各服务器看到: Queries several STUN servers for their public mappings and compares ports: identical ports suggest cone NAT; different ports suggest symmetric NAT. Heuristic only, not a precise detection.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「推断 NAT」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Infer NAT" above to start.
map.每个 STUN 服务器看到的公网 IP:端口: Public IP:port seen by each STUN server
map.这是启发式推断，受多出口、运营商多级 NAT、STUN 可用性影响，仅供网络排查: Heuristic inference affected by multi-homing, carrier NAT tiers and STUN availability — for troubleshooting reference only.
map.锥形 NAT 对外端口固定，便于 P2P 直连；对称 NAT 对每目标分配不同端: Cone NAT uses a fixed external port (easier P2P); symmetric assigns a different port per destination (harder to traverse).
map.少于 2 个 STUN 返回有效映射时无法比较，通常是网络限制或 STUN 不可: Fewer than 2 valid STUN mappings to compare, usually network restrictions or unreachable STUN.
